title: Post-phase boundary validation cleanup
summary: Fixes issues uncovered by the post-Phase 7 broad Python confidence pass: updates stale mDNS test patch targets, realigns schema key-order constants with settings metadata, classifies a command-bearing Libraries panel as interactive, and refreshes generated test/report/summary artifacts.
reason: The targeted Phase 7 gates were clean, but the full Python discovery suite exposed stale tests and generated artifacts left by the seven-phase boundary cleanup series. These fixes make the broader suite and generated-context gate pass without changing media/runtime behavior.

Generated summary freshness also reported missing summaries for several changed files.
